item.title: Auction of Government of India Dated Security
item.description: Government of India (GoI) has announced the sale (re-issue) of one dated security for a notified amount of ₹34,000 crore: 6.94% GS 2036, auction on July 31, 2026, settlement on August 03, 2026. GoI Notification

item.title: RBI issues Draft (Securitisation Transactions) Amendment Directions
item.description: The Reserve Bank of India today released the Draft (Securitisation Transactions) Amendment Directions for public comments.

item.title: RBI imposes monetary penalty on Raigad District Central Co-operative Bank Ltd., Maharashtra
item.description: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has, by an order dated July 23, 2026, imposed a monetary penalty of Rs.10.10 lakh on Raigad District Central Co-operative Bank Ltd., Maharashtra for contravention of provisions of section 20(1) read with section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949.
